November 12, 1959
Here is the advance story on
TWA's newest Jet service....
Within a few days, you will be able to fly non-stop from
New York to Europe on the newest, fastest and largest jet-
liner in the world...non-stop to London or Paris and non-
stop on the return flight across the Atlantic.
This brochure tells the story...about the wonderful new
plane which makes this possible and about the delightful
experiences a flight aboard this plane will be.
Service to
London and Frankfurt starts November 23...shortly thereafter
to Parie and Rome.
No matter where you start your trip, from any point in the
U.S.A., TWA's new jet service will cut many valuable hours
from your travel time.
We look forward to welcoming you aboard soon.
I prechal
Vice-President and
General Sales Manager
